environment.description: EKS pod running in namespace 'build-system' with default service account. The gRPC server is exposed via a Kubernetes Service of type ClusterIP, with an nginx ingress controller performing TLS termination (server-side only). Any pod within the cluster VPC can reach the service on port 8443. The pod's filesystem is a standard EBS-backed PV mounted at /var/lib/artifacts with no read-only constraints. The container runs as uid 1000 but has write access to the entire container filesystem including /etc/cron.d, /tmp, and the artifact extraction directory. No NetworkPolicy restricts ingress to the pod. The server's mTLS configuration in code uses require_client_auth=True, but the ingress terminates TLS upstream and forwards plaintext gRPC to the pod's sidecar envoy which re-wraps without client cert validation, effectively bypassing the mTLS requirement at the application layer.

config.service_mesh: envoy sidecar without client cert forwarding
